versions.subject: add tieto dns exfil rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    query_length: "> 70"              # IS MORE THAN 70 bytes
default_list_of_well_known_domains:
    query_etld_plus_one:
        - "akadns.net"
        - "akamaiedge.net"
        - "amazonaws.com"
        - "apple.com"
        - "apple-dns.net"
        - "cloudfront.net"
        - "icloud.com"
        - "in-addr.arpa"
        - "google.com"
        - "yahoo.com"
        - "dropbox.com"
        - "windowsupdate.com"
        - "microsoftonline.com"
        - "s-microsoft.com"
        - "office365.com"
        - "linkedin.com"
condition: selection and not default_list_of_well_known_domains
